verdict.rationale: Navan's API/MCP evidence shows card transactions, custom-field management, receipts, and flagged/policy-violation queries, which support structured expense capture and review, but there's no direct evidence of automatic merchant/category/memo tagging at time of purchase or a described month-end close workflow. missing for 10: explicit automatic categorization at transaction time, memo auto-generation, and a documented close/reconciliation workflow.
